list.title: Datasets
list.help: Datasets in Langfuse are a collection of inputs (and expected outputs) of an LLM application. They are used to benchmark new releases before deployment to production. See docs to learn more.
list.name: Name

actions.deleteDescription: This action cannot be undone and removes all the data associated with this dataset.

items.title: Items
items.sourceTooltip: Link to the source trace based on which this item was added
items.archiveDescription: Archiving an item will exclude it from new dataset runs.
items.unarchiveDescription: Unarchiving an item will include it back in new dataset runs.
items.confirmDeleteItem: Are you sure you want to delete this item? This will also delete all run items that belong to this item.

experiments.title: Run Experiment
experiments.description: Experiments allow you to test iterations of your application or prompt on a dataset. Learn more about experiments
experiments.runDescription: Run an experiment to evaluate prompts and model configurations against a dataset. See
experiments.viaUIDescription: Test single prompts and model configurations via Langfuse UI.
experiments.viaSDKDescription: Start any dataset run via the Langfuse SDKs. To configure runs via webhook, use the button below.

viaSDKFeatures.fullControl: Full control over dataset run execution

promptModelStep.title: Prompt & Model Configuration
promptModelStep.description: Select the prompt version and configure the model parameters for your experiment.
promptModelStep.structuredOutputEnabled: Configure the schema for structured LLM outputs
promptModelStep.structuredOutputDisabled: Enable to enforce a specific output format

datasetStep.title: Dataset Selection
datasetStep.description: Choose the dataset to run your experiment on. The dataset structure must match the prompt template variables.
datasetStep.versionDescription: Run the experiment using the dataset state at a specific point in time. Defaults to the latest version.
datasetStep.matchesBetweenItems: Matches between dataset items and prompt variables/placeholders
datasetStep.itemsMissingVariables: Items missing all required variables and placeholders will be excluded from the dataset run.

evaluatorsStep.title: Evaluators (Optional)
evaluatorsStep.description: Configure evaluators to automatically score experiment results. You can add multiple evaluators to assess different aspects of your LLM outputs.
evaluatorsStep.noPermission: You don't have permission to manage evaluators
evaluatorsStep.selectDatasetFirst: Please select a dataset first to configure evaluators

detailsStep.title: Experiment Run Details
detailsStep.description: Provide a name and optional description for your experiment to help identify and track it.
detailsStep.descriptionPlaceholder: Describe the purpose or context of this experiment

reviewStep.title: Review & Run
reviewStep.description: Review your experiment configuration before running it. You can go back to any step to make changes.
reviewStep.name: Name:
reviewStep.runNameTooltip: This run name is auto-generated from the experiment name and can be used to fetch the resulting experiment run via the public API.

compare.help: Compare your dataset runs side by side
